_comment: Classes, levels 1-10. Features are simplified 5e (SRD 5.1, CC-BY-4.0), fought on the battle grid. 'rule' tags are used by game systems; kits are starting equipment packages (item ids from items.json).

fighter.name: Fighter
fighter.description: A trained killer: soldier, mercenary, bodyguard or duellist. Fighters wear the best armour they can afford and know how to use every weapon in the rack.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.text: A trained way of fighting, chosen at creation: a Fighting Style feat.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.text: The tricks of three kinds of weapon, four from level 4, five from level 10 and six from 16: a mace that knocks a man down, a rapier that leaves an opening. Change them after a long rest.

features.name: Second Wind
features.text: A bonus action to catch your breath in battle: 1d10 + your level in hit points. Twice between long rests (three times from level 4, four from 10); a short rest brings back one.

features.name: Action Surge
features.text: Once per rest, push past exhaustion and take one more action on your turn (twice per rest from level 17, never twice in a turn).

features.name: Tactical Mind
features.text: When an ability check fails, a use of Second Wind adds 1d10 to it; if it still fails, the use is not spent.

features.name: Martial Archetype
features.text: Choose how you fight: Champion or Knight.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: +2 to one ability, or +1 to two.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.text: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Tactical Shift
features.text: Second Wind also lets you move up to half your speed, slipping away from the foes around you.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: Fighters train harder than anyone: +2 to one ability, or +1 to two.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: +2 to one ability, or +1 to two.

features.name: Indomitable
features.text: A failed saving throw rolled again, adding your level. Once between long rests (twice from level 13, three times from 17).

features.name: Tactical Master
features.text: With a weapon whose mastery you know, a blow may push, sap or slow instead of its own trick.

features.name: Two Extra Attacks
features.text: Attack three times when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: +2 to one ability, or +1 to two, or a feat.

features.name: Studied Attacks
features.text: A missed attack teaches you: your next attack on that foe before the end of your next turn has advantage.

features.name: Indomitable (two uses)
features.text: Indomitable twice between long rests.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: +2 to one ability, or +1 to two, or a feat.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: +2 to one ability, or +1 to two, or a feat.

features.name: Action Surge (two uses)
features.text: Action Surge twice between rests, once in a turn; Indomitable three times between long rests.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.text: A gift of legend: an epic boon (or another feat), each raising one ability as high as 30.

features.name: Three Extra Attacks
features.text: Attack four times when you take the Attack action.

champion.name: Champion
champion.text: Raw skill and endurance: the blow that ends it, and the will to stand after.

features.name: Improved Critical
features.text: Your weapon attacks and unarmed strikes score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

features.name: Remarkable Athlete
features.text: Advantage on initiative and on Strength (Athletics) checks; after a critical hit you may move up to half your speed, slipping away from the foes around you.

features.name: Additional Fighting Style
features.text: Learn a second fighting style.

features.name: Heroic Warrior
features.text: In a fight, you start each of your turns with Heroic Inspiration if you have none.

features.name: Superior Critical
features.text: Your weapon attacks and unarmed strikes score a critical hit on a roll of 18 to 20.

features.name: Survivor
features.text: Advantage on death saves, and an 18 or 19 counts as a 20. At the start of each of your turns, while you are bloodied and still standing, you regain 5 + your Constitution modifier in hit points.

knight.name: Knight
knight.text: A shield for others: you hold the line and draw the enemy's blows.

features.name: Hold the Line
features.text: An enemy beside you has disadvantage attacking anyone but you.

features.name: Commanding Presence
features.text: Add your Wisdom bonus to Persuasion and Intimidation when giving orders or demanding surrender.

features.name: Rallying Cry
features.text: When you use Second Wind, friends within 30 feet regain hit points equal to your level.

features.name: Unyielding
features.text: Once between long rests, a blow that would drop you leaves you standing with hit points equal to your level.

features.name: Warden of the Line
features.text: Hold the Line reaches ten feet: an enemy within two strides of you strikes badly at anyone but you.

battle_master.name: Battle Master
battle_master.text: A student of the art of war: superiority dice spent on maneuvers that trip, parry, riposte, rally and command.

features.name: Combat Superiority
features.text: Superiority dice (four d8s; a fifth at level 7, a sixth at 15) spent on maneuvers, all back after a short rest. Three maneuvers known, two more at levels 7, 10 and 15; one maneuver an attack; their saves are against 8 + your Strength or Dexterity modifier + your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Student of War
features.text: Proficiency with one kind of artisan's tools, and in one skill of the fighter's choosing.

features.name: Know Your Enemy
features.text: A bonus action: a creature you see within 30 feet is weighed up, its immunities, resistances and weaknesses laid bare. Once a long rest, or for a superiority die.

features.name: More Maneuvers
features.text: Two more maneuvers.

features.name: Improved Combat Superiority
features.text: Your superiority dice become d10s.

features.name: More Maneuvers
features.text: Two more maneuvers.

features.name: Relentless
features.text: Once a turn, a maneuver rolls a d8 of its own instead of spending a superiority die.

features.name: More Maneuvers
features.text: Two more maneuvers.

features.name: Ultimate Combat Superiority
features.text: Your superiority dice become d12s.

eldritch_knight.name: Eldritch Knight
eldritch_knight.text: A fighter who studies the wizard's art: spells to shield the body and to strike many foes at once, a weapon bound to the hand.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.text: Two wizard cantrips (a third at level 10) and wizard spells of levels 1 to 4 prepared from the whole wizard list: three at level 3, thirteen at 20, cast with Intelligence. The list changes as you gain a level, not after a rest.

features.name: War Bond
features.text: Up to two weapons bound to you by an hour's ritual (done at a short rest): never knocked from your hand, and called back to it with a bonus action from wherever they are, in a fight or after a theft.

features.name: War Magic
features.text: When you take the Attack action, one of its attacks may be a wizard cantrip cast with an action instead.

features.name: Eldritch Strike
features.text: A creature you hit with a weapon has Disadvantage on its next save against a spell of yours before the end of your next turn.

features.name: Arcane Charge
features.text: When you use Action Surge, you may first teleport up to 30 feet to a space you can see.

features.name: Improved War Magic
features.text: When you take the Attack action, two of its attacks may be a wizard spell of level 1 or 2 cast with an action instead.

maneuver_ambush.name: Ambush
maneuver_ambush.text: A superiority die added to a Stealth check or to Initiative (not while incapacitated).

maneuver_bait_and_switch.name: Bait and Switch
maneuver_bait_and_switch.text: On your turn, 5 feet of movement: you and a willing friend beside you swap places without drawing blows; one of you adds the die to AC until your next turn.

maneuver_commander_s_strike.name: Commander's Strike
maneuver_commander_s_strike.text: Give up one attack of your Attack action: a friend who sees or hears you strikes at once with their reaction, adding the die to the damage.

maneuver_commanding_presence.name: Commanding Presence
maneuver_commanding_presence.text: A superiority die added to an Intimidation, Performance or Persuasion check.

maneuver_disarming_attack.name: Disarming Attack
maneuver_disarming_attack.text: On a hit, the die to the damage; a Strength save, or the foe drops what it holds (its weapon lies at its feet until its next turn).

maneuver_distracting_strike.name: Distracting Strike
maneuver_distracting_strike.text: On a hit, the die to the damage; the next attack on that foe by someone else before your next turn has advantage.

maneuver_evasive_footwork.name: Evasive Footwork
maneuver_evasive_footwork.text: A bonus action: Disengage, and the die added to your AC until your next turn.

maneuver_feinting_attack.name: Feinting Attack
maneuver_feinting_attack.text: A bonus action: a feint at a foe beside you. Advantage on your next attack at it this turn, and the die to the damage if it hits.

maneuver_goading_attack.name: Goading Attack
maneuver_goading_attack.text: On a hit, the die to the damage; a Wisdom save, or the foe strikes badly at anyone but you until the end of your next turn.

maneuver_lunging_attack.name: Lunging Attack
maneuver_lunging_attack.text: A bonus action: Dash. Having moved at least 5 feet, your next melee hit this turn adds the die to the damage.

maneuver_maneuvering_attack.name: Maneuvering Attack
maneuver_maneuvering_attack.text: On a hit, the die to the damage; a friend who sees or hears you may use their reaction to move half their speed, drawing no blows from your foe.

maneuver_menacing_attack.name: Menacing Attack
maneuver_menacing_attack.text: On a hit, the die to the damage; a Wisdom save, or the foe is frightened until the end of your next turn.

maneuver_parry.name: Parry
maneuver_parry.text: A reaction when a melee attack roll hurts you: the damage is less by the die plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier.

maneuver_precision_attack.name: Precision Attack
maneuver_precision_attack.text: When you miss with an attack roll: the die added to it, perhaps turning the miss into a hit.

maneuver_pushing_attack.name: Pushing Attack
maneuver_pushing_attack.text: On a hit with a weapon or unarmed strike, the die to the damage; a Large or smaller foe makes a Strength save or is pushed up to 15 feet away.

maneuver_rally.name: Rally
maneuver_rally.text: A bonus action: a friend within 50 feet who sees or hears you gains temporary hit points: the die plus half your fighter level.

maneuver_riposte.name: Riposte
maneuver_riposte.text: A reaction when a foe misses you in melee: strike back at it, adding the die to the damage if you hit.

maneuver_sweeping_attack.name: Sweeping Attack
maneuver_sweeping_attack.text: On a melee hit, the blow carries on into another foe beside the first and within your reach: if the roll would hit it, it takes the die in damage of the same kind.

maneuver_tactical_assessment.name: Tactical Assessment
maneuver_tactical_assessment.text: A superiority die added to a History, Investigation or Insight check.

maneuver_trip_attack.name: Trip Attack
maneuver_trip_attack.text: On a hit with a weapon or unarmed strike, the die to the damage; a Large or smaller foe makes a Strength save or falls prone.

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.description: Thief, spy, scout or cutthroat. Rogues live by quick hands, sharp eyes and the knife in the dark, and they rarely fight fair.

features.name: Expertise
features.text: Double your proficiency bonus with two chosen skills.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.text: Once per turn, deal extra damage (1d6, growing every other level to 10d6) when you have advantage, or an ally is fighting your target.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.text: The tricks of two kinds of weapon (a rapier that leaves an opening, a dagger quick enough for a second stab). Change them after a long rest.

features.name: Thieves' Cant
features.text: The secret slang and signs of the criminal world.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.text: Dash, Disengage or Hide with a bonus action, and still attack in the same turn.

features.name: Roguish Archetype
features.text: Choose your trade: Thief or Assassin.

features.name: Steady Aim
features.text: A bonus action, before you have moved: advantage on your next attack this turn, and you stand still for the rest of it.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: +2 to one ability, or +1 to two.

features.name: Cunning Strike
features.text: Give up Sneak Attack dice for a trick: poison (1d6, with a poisoner's kit), trip (1d6) or withdraw (1d6).

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.text: Once per round, halve the damage of an attack you can see.

features.name: Expertise
features.text: Two more skills gain double proficiency.

features.name: Evasion
features.text: Take no damage from area effects you save against, and half if you fail.

features.name: Reliable Talent
features.text: A check with a skill or tool you are trained in never rolls lower than 10.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: +2 to one ability, or +1 to two.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: +2 to one ability, or +1 to two.

features.name: Improved Cunning Strike
features.text: Two Cunning Strike tricks on one blow, paying for each.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: +2 to one ability, or +1 to two, or a feat.

features.name: Devious Strikes
features.text: New Cunning Strike tricks: daze (2d6), obscure (3d6) and knock out (6d6).

features.name: Slippery Mind
features.text: Proficiency in Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: +2 to one ability, or +1 to two, or a feat.

features.name: Elusive
features.text: No attack roll against you has advantage, unless you are incapacitated.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.text: A gift of legend: an epic boon (or another feat), each raising one ability as high as 30.

features.name: Stroke of Luck
features.text: Once between rests, a failed attack roll or saving throw becomes a 20.

thief.name: Thief
thief.text: Burglar, climber, treasure hunter: the adventurer of the old tales.

features.name: Fast Hands
features.text: Use an item, pick a lock or a pocket with a bonus action.

features.name: Second-Story Work
features.text: Climb as fast as you walk, and leap by your Dexterity.

features.name: Supreme Sneak
features.text: A new Cunning Strike trick: Stealth Attack (1d6), and the blow does not give away where you hide.

features.name: Use Magic Device
features.text: Bound to four magic things instead of three; a power that spends charges keeps them on a 6.

features.name: Thief's Reflexes
features.text: In the first round of a fight you act twice over: a second action, bonus action and move.

assassin.name: Assassin
assassin.text: Killer for hire, spy and bounty hunter: the first blow is the last.

features.name: Assassinate
features.text: Advantage on initiative; in the first round, advantage against anyone who has not yet acted, and a Sneak Attack then adds your level in damage.

features.name: Assassin's Tools
features.text: A disguise kit and a poisoner's kit, and the training to use them.

features.name: Infiltration Expertise
features.text: You mimic speech and hand perfectly, and Steady Aim no longer roots you to the spot.

features.name: Envenom Weapons
features.text: The poison of a Cunning Strike also deals 2d6 poison damage on a failed save, through any resistance.

features.name: Death Strike
features.text: A Sneak Attack in the first round of a fight: a Constitution save, or the blow's damage is doubled.

arcane_trickster.name: Arcane Trickster
arcane_trickster.text: A rogue who sharpens stealth with spells: an unseen hand that picks pockets and locks, magic out of hiding, and at the last, spells stolen from the minds of casters.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.text: Mage Hand and two more wizard cantrips (a fourth at level 10) and wizard spells of levels 1 to 4 of any school prepared from the wizard list: three at level 3, thirteen at 20, cast with Intelligence. The list changes as you gain a level, not after a rest.

features.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
features.text: Your Mage Hand is unseen and cast with a bonus action, and steered with one: through it you pick pockets and rob stalls from 30 feet away, and nobody sees who did it.

features.name: Magical Ambush
features.text: While you are Invisible (hidden counts), a creature you cast a spell on has Disadvantage on its saves against it this turn.

features.name: Versatile Trickster
features.text: When a Cunning Strike trips a creature, your Mage Hand trips another within 5 feet of it too.

features.name: Spell Thief
features.text: Once a long rest, as a reaction to a spell cast at you: the caster makes an Intelligence save against your spell DC, and on a failure the spell does nothing to you, and you know it for 8 hours (the caster cannot cast it until then).

cleric.name: Cleric
cleric.description: A priest with a god's power in their hands. Temples hold divine magic jealously; a cleric heals, blesses and condemns in the name of a faith, and answers to its hierarchy.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.text: Pray each morning for the prayers your god will grant today.

features.name: Divine Order
features.text: Your sacred role: Protector (martial weapons and heavy armour) or Thaumaturge (one more cantrip, and your Wisdom added to Arcana and Religion).

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.text: Call on your god directly: Divine Spark (heal or harm, 1d8 + Wisdom, more dice at 7, 13 and 18) or Turn Undead. Twice between long rests (three times from 6, four from 18); a short rest brings back one.

features.name: Divine Domain
features.text: Your god's aspect: Life or War.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: +2 to one ability, or +1 to two.

features.name: Sear Undead
features.text: Undead that fail against your Turn Undead also burn: a d8 of radiant damage for each point of your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Blessed Strikes
features.text: Divine Strike (once a turn, a weapon hit deals 1d8 radiant more) or Potent Spellcasting (your Wisdom added to a cleric cantrip's damage).

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: +2 to one ability, or +1 to two.

features.name: Divine Intervention
features.text: Once between long rests, your god answers: a cleric spell of level 5 or lower cast without a slot, as one action.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: +2 to one ability, or +1 to two, or a feat.

features.name: Improved Blessed Strikes
features.text: Divine Strike deals 2d8; Potent Spellcasting's cantrips also give twice your Wisdom in temporary hit points to you or a friend.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: +2 to one ability, or +1 to two, or a feat.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.text: A gift of legend: an epic boon (or another feat), each raising one ability as high as 30.

features.name: Greater Divine Intervention
features.text: Divine Intervention may ask for a Wish (when Wish comes into the world), and then not again for 2d4 long rests.

order_protector.name: Protector
order_protector.text: Trained for battle: martial weapons and heavy armour.

order_thaumaturge.name: Thaumaturge
order_thaumaturge.text: One more cantrip, and your Wisdom modifier (at least +1) added to Arcana and Religion checks.

blessed_divine_strike.name: Divine Strike
blessed_divine_strike.text: Once on each of your turns, a weapon hit deals 1d8 radiant damage more (2d8 from level 14).

blessed_potent_spellcasting.name: Potent Spellcasting
blessed_potent_spellcasting.text: Your Wisdom modifier added to the damage of your cleric cantrips (and from level 14, temporary hit points for you or a friend).

life.name: Life Domain
life.text: Healers and midwives of the faith.

features.name: Life Domain Spells
features.text: Always prepared, beyond your count: Aid, Bless, Cure Wounds and Lesser Restoration; Mass Healing Word and Revivify from 5; Aura of Life and Death Ward from 7; Greater Restoration and Mass Cure Wounds from 9.

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.text: Your healing spells restore 2 + the spell's level extra hit points.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Preserve Life
features.text: Share out healing equal to five times your level among the wounded within 30 feet (none past half their hit points).

features.name: Blessed Healer
features.text: Healing someone else with a spell heals you too: 2 + the spell's level.

features.name: Supreme Healing
features.text: Your healing spells and Divine Spark heal their most: every die counts as its highest.

war.name: War Domain
war.text: Chaplains of armies and the gods of battle.

features.name: War Domain Spells
features.text: Always prepared, beyond your count: Guiding Bolt, Magic Weapon, Shield of Faith and Spiritual Weapon; Crusader's Mantle and Spirit Guardians from 5; Fire Shield and Freedom of Movement from 7; Hold Monster and Steel Wind Strike from 9.

features.name: War Priest
features.text: A weapon attack with a bonus action, as many times as your Wisdom modifier (at least once) between short rests.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Guided Strike
features.text: Add +10 to an attack roll that would miss: your own, or a friend's within 30 feet.

features.name: War God's Blessing
features.text: A use of Channel Divinity casts Shield of Faith or Spiritual Weapon without a slot, and it lasts its minute without your concentration.

features.name: Avatar of Battle
features.text: Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.

wizard.name: Wizard
wizard.description: A scholar of forbidden power. Wizards learn magic from books, at ruinous cost in years and coin; some kingdoms license them, others burn them.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.text: Cast spells from your spellbook; copy new ones from scrolls and books (two hours and 50 coins a level), and two more come with every level.

features.name: Ritual Adept
features.text: Any ritual in your spellbook can be cast as a ritual, read from the book: ten minutes longer, and no spell slot.

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.text: Once between long rests, a short rest with your spellbook brings back spent spell slots: levels adding up to half your level (rounded up), none of level 6 or higher.

features.name: Scholar
features.text: A field of study besides magic: Expertise in one of Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature or Religion that you know.

features.name: Wizard Subclass
features.text: Your school: the Evoker or the Abjurer.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: +2 to one ability, or +1 to two, or a feat.

features.name: Memorize Spell
features.text: After a short rest, one spell you have prepared may be swapped for another from your spellbook.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: +2 to one ability, or +1 to two, or a feat.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: +2 to one ability, or +1 to two, or a feat.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: +2 to one ability, or +1 to two, or a feat.

features.name: Spell Mastery
features.text: A level 1 and a level 2 spell from your spellbook, each cast with an action, are yours at will: cast at their own level without a slot.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.text: A gift of legend: an epic boon (or another feat), each raising one ability as high as 30. Boon of Spell Recall suits a wizard.

features.name: Signature Spells
features.text: Two level 3 spells from your spellbook become your signature: each can be cast once at level 3 without a slot, and comes back with a short or long rest.

evocation.name: Evoker
evocation.text: Fire, frost, thunder and lightning, aimed like artillery.

features.name: Evocation Savant
features.text: Two evocation spells of level 1 or 2 copied into your spellbook for nothing, and one more each time a new level of spell slots opens.

features.name: Potent Cantrip
features.text: A damaging cantrip that misses, or that its target saves against, still does half its damage (and nothing else).

features.name: Sculpt Spells
features.text: Your evocations leave out friends you can see: as many as one plus the spell's level are untouched.

features.name: Empowered Evocation
features.text: Your Intelligence modifier added to one damage roll of each wizard evocation.

features.name: Overchannel
features.text: A damaging wizard spell of level 1 to 5 cast with a slot does its greatest damage. Free the first time between long rests; after that it costs 2d12 necrotic for each slot level, a d12 more each time.

abjuration.name: Abjurer
abjuration.text: Wards, seals and banishings; the shield of companions.

features.name: Abjuration Savant
features.text: Two abjuration spells of level 1 or 2 copied into your spellbook for nothing, and one more each time a new level of spell slots opens.

features.name: Arcane Ward
features.text: Your first abjuration cast with a slot after a long rest weaves a ward (twice your level + Intelligence) that takes damage meant for you; each abjuration after mends it by twice the slot's level, and a bonus action can spend a slot to do the same.

features.name: Projected Ward
features.text: With your reaction, the ward takes the damage of a creature you can see within 30 feet.

features.name: Spell Breaker
features.text: Counterspell and Dispel Magic are always ready for you; Dispel Magic takes only a bonus action and adds your proficiency to its check; a slot spent on either is kept if the spell does not stop a spell.

features.name: Spell Resistance
features.text: Advantage on saving throws against spells, and resistance to the damage of spells.
